assertion_analysis.fails_if: Fixture accidentally carries crew.json, flight.yaml or runs; setup invariant, not runtime coverage.
Either guard recognises static-only output or fails to recognise review history; restoring index.json breaks the static branch.
Native spawn is refused for the static fixture, allowed for review history, omits refusal/project text or emits a message for static-only output.
Peer send to a verified live worker has the wrong permission for either population, omits refusal/recipient text or emits a message for static-only output.
CLI recognition accepts static-only output or ignores reviews.

Fallback fails to resolve sample for review history, succeeds for static-only output, raises a different refusal, or reads a ledger for the excluded population; restoring index.json triggers a forbidden ledger read and successful lookup.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares a production echo with the same supplied value: has_reviews configures files but is not passed to production, sample is an independently fixed expected project, and reads observes side effects.

importer_delta.note: Both logs completed with identical seven FAILED ids; importer head is the production repair commit, followed only by an evidence fragment.
